text: A press operator was trying to remove a stuck part from the die by hand when the mechanical power press cycled. The tip of his right index finger was amputated. He was taken to the hospital.
An employee was walking through the warehouse aisle when a forklift that was backing up struck him. He suffered a fractured left leg and was hospitalized.

While clearing a jam on a running belt conveyor in the packaging line, an employee reached under the guard and her left hand was pulled into the pinch point at the tail pulley. She suffered crushing injuries and two fractured fingers.

An employee was draining an industrial fryer at a snack food plant when the drain valve opened suddenly and hot oil splashed onto his forearms. He sustained second-degree burns and was admitted to the hospital.
